notes: Near-misses are deliberately khenrix-upgrade's and khenrix-audit's territory: all three act on this machine's CLI config, and the descriptions are adjacent enough that a sloppy edit to any of them would cross-fire. This file and evals/khenrix-upgrade/triggers.json are mirrors — each one's should_trigger cases are the other's near_misses — so a description edit that blurs the boundary fails on BOTH sides rather than silently passing one.
should_trigger: sync my Claude Code config with the shared khenrix source of truth
install the shared MCP servers on this machine
add what's missing from my settings without removing anything machine-specific
set up this machine's agentic CLIs to match the house style
near_miss: research the latest Claude Code features and tune how I use them
pick a newer model for my CLI setup
which of my installed skills overlap or fire for the same prompt?
